Definition: probably a musical instrument (as being struck)
BiblicalUsage: A musical instrument is what the king gives up for the night: Darius goes to his palace and fasts, and no instrument of music is brought before him. The word appears once, in the night Daniel spends in the lions' den. The king's music stops because his conscience will not let him sleep.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the silenced music shows that a king's conscience can be louder than his orchestra, and God uses it to keep a man awake.
